question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Announcement**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Announcement **is a public or formal statement, typically conveying important information or news. (**घोषणा**)

 
 
• **Example**: *The principal made an announcement about the upcoming school event during the morning assembly.*
 
 
 
• *​*The word "**announcement**" is appropriate because it refers to a formal or public statement made to convey information.
 
• In this context, it suggests that the speaker wanted to communicate something to their daughter, possibly using a public address system or speakers.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rejects: **Refuses or declines something. (**अस्वीकृत**)
 
• **Notification: **A formal or official announcement or alert. (**अधिसूचना**)
 
• **Assertion: **A confident and forceful statement or declaration. (**अभिकथन**)
